'''Master Tobrad''' is an innkeeper in [[Hinderstap]] 
==History==
His Inn is where [[Joline]] and [[Edesina]] choose to stay in Hinderstap. When [[Mat]] comes to take them out of the village, they wish to wait for him, but Mat tells them he saw him dead on the floor.
